title: Join mini-dsh into one tested harness
brief: Join every module's parts into one mini-dsh: the plugin kernel and a profile mount the record, the DeepSeek adapter, the tool pipeline and sandbox, context management, agents and the JSON-RPC SDK surface. Then prove it works without trusting the model: a mock adapter for the loop, a fault server for the adapter and retry, replay tests that run recorded sessions through the JSON-RPC surface, and outcome checks that compare the files and the record. Finish with a written trace of one request through every layer, naming the dsh package that fills each one.

starter.note: The complete row list for the SDK profile: kernel services, session, persistence, llm, deepseek adapter, retry, tools, sandbox policy, bash, system prompt, compaction, agents, loop, sdk-server.
Boots the kernel from --profile, mounts every row, and fails with a clear error when a required row stays pending.
MockAdapter with a script, recorded requests, 'hang' entries, remaining(), and textReply / toolCallReply helpers.
startFaultServer(sequence) on port 0: success, rate_limit with retry-after, server_error, stall; records every request body.
deriveScript(events) from assistant/message blocks, replayAdapter(file), assertConsumed().
One folder per scenario: workspace/, workspace.expected/, session.jsonl recorded once with a real key.
Your trace of one session/prompt request through every layer, with the matching dsh package and file for each step.

hints: Boot the test harness through the same profile file as the real program and replace only the llm adapter row; a hand-built plugin tree tests a harness you never ship.
Point the DeepSeek adapter's base URL at the fault server, and give the stall test a short idle timeout so it ends in seconds.
Record a scenario with MINI_DSH_RECORD=1, then commit its session.jsonl; every later run must work with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY unset.
Copy workspace/ to a fresh temporary folder for each run, and compare the whole file list as well as each file's bytes.
Write the walkthrough from the record of a real run: each event type in the file tells you which layer was active.

rubric.criterion: The loop test uses the real tools and record with a scripted adapter and fails when the loop asks for one reply too many
A rate limit followed by success gives 2 server requests, 1 llm/retry event and the final answer; a stall ends without hanging
Replay runs a recorded session through the JSON-RPC surface with no key and fails when a recorded reply is unused
Each scenario compares every expected file byte by byte, the file list and the tool results, and never reads the final text
The SDK surface answers initialize, session/prompt and session/wait and forwards every session event
The walkthrough follows one prompt through kernel, surface, agent loop, record, context, model adapter, tool pipeline and sandbox, each with its dsh package

milestones.title: One profile mounts the whole harness
milestones.body: Write profiles/sdk.yml and src/main.ts. In test/boot.test.ts, boot the profile, assert that every row is active, then disable the llm row with a patch and assert that the loop stays pending instead of failing later.

milestones.title: The loop under a scripted model
milestones.body: Boot the profile with the llm row replaced by MockAdapter. Script a count_lines call and a text reply, then assert the second request carries the tool result for call_1 and that a third request throws script exhausted.

milestones.title: The adapter and retry under real failures
milestones.body: Run the real DeepSeek adapter against the fault server with ['rate_limit', 'success'] and then with ['stall']. Assert request counts, the llm/retry event, the final text, and that the stall ends with an error turn within 10 seconds.

milestones.title: Replay through the JSON-RPC surface
milestones.body: Record test/scenarios/add-done once over JSON-RPC with a real key. Then replay it: spawn src/main.ts --profile sdk with the replay adapter, send initialize and session/prompt as JSON lines, wait with session/wait, and call assertConsumed().

milestones.title: Outcome checks and the walkthrough
milestones.body: Compare the replayed run's workspace with workspace.expected/ byte by byte, check the file list and the tool results, and write WALKTHROUGH.md: one session/prompt request, layer by layer, with the dsh package for each step.
milestones.checkCmd: env -u DEEPSEEK_API_KEY npx tsx test/outcome.test.ts && test -s WALKTHROUGH.md
